description: Writes replies to Google reviews for small businesses: personal replies that name one specific thing, calm replies to bad reviews, and quick one-liners. Never invents details.

defaultPrompt: Write replies to my latest Google reviews.
interface.longDescription: Review Replier helps small business owners answer Google reviews in minutes. Paste one review or the whole week's batch, and it writes a short reply that names one specific thing from the review, a calm professional reply to bad reviews with a way to take it offline, and quick one-liners for the short ones. It never makes up details about the job, never argues in public, and never posts anything for you.
interface.shortDescription: Reply to Google reviews in minutes

name: review-replier
